review.notes: Full re-review after a 326-line repair. The previous review's four findings are repaired: the five GeometricTopology gaps (oriented-linking-number, seifert-matrix-s-equivalence, alexander-module-presentation narrowed to the cover and Crowell with MorseNovikov N6 cited for the presentation, finite-quadratic-arf, three-manifold-smoothing) are declared and named at every use; the slice-disc comparison is split into a smooth §1.4 branch with its own Needs line and a locally flat §3.6 branch; the parameter-projection names carry the TauCeti prefix; the listed typography is fixed. Seeded sample (15 targets) verified at the cached texts: freedmanquinn 2.9.1, 7.5, 7.6, §7.8, 8.2, 9.6, §9.12, 10.10, 11.5, 11.11, §11.9; powellrayteichner Theorem A, (1.1), Def 3.2; krushkalquinn p. 408; feehanleness Thm 3, §3.1; bastletal 5.3, 6.5; tancer Thms 1-2, Prop 5; gompfstipsicz 1.2.25, 1.2.33; milnor1959 Thm 1/Cor 1; brown1960 Thms 4-5. Gate re-run OK (all scanners 0, build passes; lake env lean gives exactly six sorry warnings); depcheck 204 roadmaps, 1404 edges, 0 problems. Adversarial table of 52 rows with computed values (588 2x2 Seifert-type matrices confirm Levine's congruence and the mod-8 Arf criterion). One-tactic padding probe on a scratch copy: none of the six sorried theorems closes. Two P3 notes: a joined token and three works cited inline but absent from the reference list. Moise, Munkres, Whitehead 1961, Lickorish, Rolfsen, Robertello, Gompf 1983 (landing page only) not readable: cited by locator.
